items.title: 2026-10-10 ★ HTC - Update
items.text:
→ Safer recovery when access restrictions change during movement.
→ Janitors can now wait outside occupied clinical rooms.
→ Improved bathroom handling for individual stalls, shared facilities and collapsed patients.

items.title: 2026-10-12 ★ HPO - Update
items.text:
→ Porters can now help other departments across floors while keeping local work priority.
→ Safer sample pickup around occupied procedure rooms, with outside waiting and improved sample-cart handling.
→ Smarter patient and sample fallback retries, with staffing alerts when more Porters may be needed.
